clinical_evidence.transcript_text:
person_1 (NURSE) 0.76-7.12s: Doctor, your next patient is here. I've done the basics, I'll read them out in a moment.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 9.00-12.07s: Thank you. Right, hello, what's the problem?
person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER) 14.01-17.00s: Doctor, thank you for seeing us.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 18.05-21.80s: That's fine, sit down. We'll go through it together.
person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER) 23.14-27.93s: He's been feeling anxious most of the day, doctor.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 29.72-32.60s: How long are we talking about?
person_4 (PATIENT) 34.21-42.52s: I'm not sure when it began, to be honest. Some weeks ago, but I can't say how many.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 44.33-47.08s: What makes it worse, if anything?
person_4 (PATIENT) 48.53-53.14s: I notice it more with work and crowded places.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 53.81-57.73s: How would you describe it, mild, moderate, severe?
person_4 (PATIENT) 58.33-60.26s: I'd call it moderate.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 60.98-62.73s: Does anything settle it?
person_4 (PATIENT) 64.66-72.70s: Deep breathing helps a bit. Oh, and trouble falling asleep. I've also been feeling on edge.
person_1 (NURSE) 73.81-83.25s: Doctor, I've got the readings for you. Temperature 36.5, heart rate 84, blood pressure 121 over 72. Respiratory rate 18.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 85.04-85.74s: Thanks.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 88.36-91.97s: Okay, if you're comfortable, I'll examine you now.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 93.47-95.88s: Let me just check something.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 110.08-114.38s: Pulse is regular and you're breathing comfortably right now.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 116.88-123.46s: Okay, that's fine, sit up. Any fainting, chest pain on exertion or weight loss at all?
person_4 (PATIENT) 123.97-130.85s: Hmm, I haven't had fainting, chest pain on exertion or weight loss, no.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 132.27-135.97s: Any low mood or alcohol use at all?
person_4 (PATIENT) 137.26-140.07s: No, not any of them.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 141.38-143.68s: Has your skin been okay?
person_4 (PATIENT) 145.00-145.89s: No rashes.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 146.62-148.64s: Alright, any regular medication?
person_4 (PATIENT) 149.44-152.67s: No, I don't take anything regularly.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 153.65-156.22s: Now some background about your lifestyle.
person_4 (PATIENT) 157.01-169.28s: I eat out quite a lot, to be honest. Yes, I live on my own. I drive a delivery van all day.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 181.95-185.89s: Anyone in the family with similar problems or other conditions?
person_4 (PATIENT) 187.21-190.07s: My father had a heart attack.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 192.05-194.96s: Have you had any surgery before?
person_4 (PATIENT) 195.62-204.32s: Just my tonsils out, when I was a child. I took the morning off to come in today.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 221.24-224.92s: Moving on to your background, any past medical history?
person_4 (PATIENT) 226.44-231.44s: I have anxiety, for about ten years. Yes, asthma.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 233.12-238.32s: Okay. Yes, anxiety is known to us, good to have that clear.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 246.83-249.29s: Any allergies I should know about?
person_4 (PATIENT) 250.68-254.42s: No allergies that I know of, no.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 255.87-265.63s: Putting it all together, this looks most like an anxiety disorder. I'd also keep a heart rhythm cause in mind.
person_4 (PATIENT) 266.27-269.91s: Is this something I'll have for good?
person_2 (DOCTOR) 273.49-283.72s: I understand the worry. At the moment I'd say it's an anxiety disorder, and we'll know more once the an ECG is back.
person_1 (NURSE) 284.63-288.24s: I've already done an ECG, it's ready for you.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 289.78-319.04s: Thanks, I'll look at that. I'd like to arrange a thyroid test for anxiety. We'll begin with escitalopram, 5 milligrams, once a day, for two weeks then review. You take it by mouth. That should help with anxiety. Slow breathing, in for four and out for six, for a few minutes whenever it builds up. I'll want another look in two weeks.
person_4 (PATIENT) 319.86-321.89s: Okay, see you then.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 327.36-330.25s: That's everything from me. Any other questions?
person_4 (PATIENT) 332.32-334.27s: Okay, thank you. Bye.
person_2 (DOCTOR) 335.10-336.82s: Mind how you go.
